# Harness index (agents)

Before a task, check this table for an owner. Read the owner's file before you proceed.
Claude Code triggers these natively; this index exists for Codex CLI and humans.

Claude Code: dispatch via the Task tool. Codex CLI: read the file and follow it, or run it isolated via `codex exec` (see AGENTS.md, CLI adapter notes).
